data.summary: The diff adds a client-side light/dark/system theme toggle (React component, theme helper, an inline pre-paint script, CSS overrides and Tailwind darkMode config). No untrusted input reaches a dangerous sink. The localStorage value is whitelisted against ['light','dark','system'] in both the helper and the inline script, and the CustomEvent detail is normalized before use. The only DOM writes are a fixed 'dark' class and colorScheme set to a fixed string. No secrets, new dependencies, network calls or server-side changes were added.
